description:
Port-map §5. Owns the output side of the terminal surface.

- OctoPi.Tui.Renderer GenServer.
- render/1 takes a list of %Line{} structs (or a component tree);
  diffs vs previous frame; emits CSI move + redraw for changed
  range only.
- find_diff_range/2: find first + last changed line index.
  emit_diff/2 pattern-matched on {first, last} with first > last
  (no changes) as its own clause — NO top-level `if`.
- Full-redraw triggers: width change, height change, overlay
  config change, component tree change. Four guards, each its
  own function head.
- CSI 2026 (synchronized output): wrap batch in "\e[?2026h" and
  "\e[?2026l" when supported; plain write otherwise. Support
  detection via DCS query at startup (cache result).
- Termux height-change suppression per upstream tui-render.test.ts.

Tests: port-map §14.5 (tui-render.test.ts, 510 lines).

TDD:
- Line-diff correctness: no-change → empty output; single-line
  change → cursor move + one line; first-line only; last-line
  only; multiple non-adjacent changes; middle-line spinner case.
- Full-redraw on width/height change.
- Termux env var suppresses height-change redraw.
- CSI 2026 wrapping when enabled.
- Shrinkage: content → empty transitions, cursor tracking on
  shrink, stale content cleared.

Depends on .1.
title: Differential renderer: screen buffer + line diff + CSI 2026
